units.source_text: “我早就这么想，可请个好大夫就得花钱。

en.t: I have thought so for a long time, but hiring a good doctor would cost money.
Besides, the master looks down on doctors,

units.source_text: 我担心请大夫给他看病，他会恼火，会当面咒骂，让人下不来台。

en.t: and I worry that if we ask a doctor to examine him, he will get angry, curse the man to his face, and leave everyone embarrassed.

units.source_text: 今早也说，大夫之辈不如指甲刀顶用呢。”

en.t: This morning too, he said that the likes of doctors are not as useful as nail clippers.
